description: Qualify existing chorus speed/depth queues in static active TREMOLO mode. Existing 35-lane capability unchanged; all 25 earlier numerical and capability contracts preserved.

host_automation_tremolo.keys: Complete existing 35-lane roster unchanged; P_chorusSpeed and P_chorusDepth remain lanes 33 and 34.
host_automation_tremolo.authority: Global speed/depth controls retain existing source independence, conversion and DSP. Fixture holds chorus on, tremolo mode and neutral width macro fixed. No mode-switch or on/off automation extension.
host_automation_tremolo.timing: Existing modern VST3 interpolation. TREMOLO keeps the BBD clock nominal; speed advances oscillator phases and depth affects stereo gains. No DSP or shared host changes.
host_automation_tremolo.verification: Bounded actual-module float32 isolated speed/depth queues, per-sample references, partitions and matched-active-constant effect controls. Off-state equality and speed-at-zero-depth equality are PCM-output controls only, not internal-state equivalence. Fixed startup/transient window, not full-cycle, steady-state, mode-switch, hardware, GUI, malformed-input or CPU qualification. Original thresholds retained; exact frozen module and host/source provenance required.
